selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What central issue does this passage say is being explained and proven in this section?
questions.answer: It is explaining the mystery of Divine oneness shown in the fact that creating the greatest thing and the smallest thing is equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: Why is this called a “mystery” in the passage?
questions.answer: Because it is a deep truth that is not obvious to ordinary reasoning and needs to be unveiled.

questions.question: What is implied by saying that philosophy is left helpless before this issue?
questions.answer: It implies that reason by itself cannot fully solve this deepest problem of creation.

questions.question: How certain does the passage say those proofs are?
questions.answer: It says they are established with the same certainty as a basic mathematical fact.

questions.question: Why are readers referred elsewhere for the full explanation?
questions.answer: Because this section chooses to present only the basis and a short outline.

questions.question: What prevented the treatment from continuing beyond the second mystery?
questions.answer: Two major barriers, one outward and one inward, stopped it.

questions.question: What does that relationship rule out?
questions.answer: It rules out any possibility of weakness entering Divine power.

questions.question: What inference does the passage make from the absence of any opposite in Divine power?
questions.answer: Divine power has no stages, no weakness, and no limitation.

questions.question: What repeated pattern in the examples of resurrection, spring, tree, and flower is meant to teach?
questions.answer: It teaches that scale does not matter to Divine power.

questions.question: What evidence from the natural world is used to support the claim of Divine ease?
questions.answer: The regular appearance of abundant, beautiful, and purposeful living things is used as evidence.

questions.question: What “mystery” is the passage mainly concerned with in this section?
questions.answer: It is concerned with how Allah creates very large and very small things with no difference in difficulty.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect this issue so strongly to faith?
questions.answer: Because understanding it strengthens belief in Allah’s power, oneness, and lordship over creation.

questions.question: How is non-revealed philosophy evaluated in this section?
questions.answer: It is shown as unable to unlock this deepest secret.

questions.question: Which work is credited with demonstrating this matter?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur is credited with demonstrating it.

questions.question: What is the purpose of this section if the detailed proofs are elsewhere?
questions.answer: Its purpose is to lay out the foundations briefly and point toward the larger explanation.

questions.question: What interrupted that plan?
questions.answer: Two serious obstacles, one material and one immaterial.

questions.question: How is that rule applied to Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Since power belongs essentially to Allah, powerlessness cannot enter His Essence.

questions.question: Why does Divine power not increase or decrease?
questions.answer: Because nothing contrary to it mixes with it, so it has no gradation.

questions.question: How does the passage use the examples of flower, tree, spring, and resurrection?
questions.answer: It uses them to show that acts that look unequal to us are equal before Allah’s power.

questions.question: In the Second Mystery, what does luminosity help explain?
questions.answer: It helps explain how one source can be manifested in many places at the same time.

questions.question: According to the opening paragraph, what truth about Divine unity is being uncovered?
questions.answer: The truth that Allah’s creating of universals and particulars is equal in ease.

questions.question: What does the passage say this explanation of the mystery makes possible for a person to understand?
questions.answer: It makes possible an understanding of the hidden secret of how all beings are created.

questions.question: What intellectual benefit comes from understanding it?
questions.answer: It helps a person grasp a hidden secret of existence that ordinary philosophy cannot solve.

questions.question: How does the passage support its high view of the Risale-i Nur’s proof?
questions.answer: By saying its arguments are decisive and as certain as an obvious mathematical truth.
